clue.text: Dejected, having moulted

definitions.meaning: low in spirits, downcast and depressed
a bird that has moulted has shed or thrown off its feathers

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both depressed in spirits and, literally, having shed one's feathers.

clue.text: Stock car, possibly with tax added

indicators.note: possibly signals another arrangement of the word car

parts.note: VAT is value added tax

explanation.surface: A used car may have tax added to its price.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' turns CAR into CRA. A stock is a wide neckband, like a cravat.
explanation.definitionFit: A stock is a broad wrapped neckcloth, a kind of neckwear like a necktie.

clue.text: An Oriental cult, so without trace

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so one word encloses the other

parts.note: taken as written
a hint is a trace or suggestion

explanation.surface: An Eastern sect that leaves no mark behind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, not lacking, so it is a container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Shinto is the native Japanese religion of nature and ancestor worship.

clue.text: Give a fellow tea freshly brewed

parts.note: a don is a college fellow

indicators.note: freshly brewed suggests the tea is stirred into a new form

explanation.surface: Offer a college tutor a newly made cup of tea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'freshly brewed' turns TEA into ATE.
explanation.definitionFit: To donate is to give as a gift.

clue.text: Nevertheless having some attraction in retirement

indicators.note: having means the first word holds the second inside

parts.note: withal is an old word for nevertheless
a draw is an attraction that pulls in crowds

explanation.surface: Even so, there is some appeal in giving up work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having' signals a container: the first word holds the other. 'in' is only a link before the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Withdrawal is a retreat or retiring from a place or activity.

clue.text: Look glum about rating work

indicators.note: about means one piece goes around the other here

parts.note: to lour is to frown or look sullen
AB, able seaman, is a naval rating

explanation.surface: Someone sulks about the job a sailor has been given.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rating' is a naval term for an ordinary sailor, not a score; 'about' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Labour is a synonym for toil or effort, the noun sense of work.

clue.text: Bill's relations

parts.note: not Bill's family but statements setting out what is owed, and also narratives

explanation.definitionFit: Statements of charges are bills, and the word also means stories or reports.

clue.text: A person coming from the Northern Isles can aid or otherwise

definitions.text: A person coming from the Northern Isles

indicators.note: otherwise means arranged in another way

explanation.surface: An islander from the far north lends a hand, or not.
explanation.walkthrough: 'otherwise' rearranges CAN AID OR. The Orkney Islands lie off northern Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Orcadian means a native of Orkney, an archipelago off the north of Scotland.

clue.text: Duplicator salesman standing over a consumer

indicators.note: standing over places the salesman above the rest in this down entry

parts.note: rep is short for representative, a travelling salesman
an eater consumes food

explanation.surface: A copier salesman looms over a customer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'standing over' only works in a down entry, where the salesman sits above the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A repeater is something that reproduces or does again, as a rifle or relay copying signals.

clue.text: Withdraw a legal right and a note will be made

parts.note: a lien is a legal right to hold property until a debt is paid
te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A lawyer's instruction about giving up a right, with a memo to follow.
explanation.walkthrough: TE is the sol-fa note also spelt TI.
explanation.definitionFit: To alienate is to estrange or turn away, withdrawing affection or, in law, transferring ownership.

clue.text: Put in charge, then step back, keeping a cool head

indicators.note: step back tells us the word for a stride is read backwards

parts.note: a pace is a step

explanation.surface: Advice to a new boss: take charge, then step aside and stay calm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' signals the reversal of the stride word. 'Put' and 'keeping' are link words; 'a cool head' is the frozen top of the planet.
explanation.definitionFit: A polar ice sheet is literally a frozen covering on top of the globe, a cold crown.

clue.text: The height and latitude should be correctly given

indicators.note: suggests the letters of the next word need to be put right, rearranged

explanation.surface: A navigator's instruction to give the height and position accurately.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of LATITUDE are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Altitude is elevation above sea level, a measure of how high something is.

clue.text: Pictures going round about German and Russian wasteland

indicators.note: about means the reversed pictures surround the German word
going round signals the word for pictures is turned backwards

parts.note: art is pictures collectively
und is German for and

explanation.surface: Paintings circulating on a German and Russian theme of barren landscape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going round' reverses the pictures word and 'about' makes it enclose the German for and; the clue's 'and' belongs to the German piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Tundra is the vast treeless frozen plain of Siberia and the Arctic.

clue.text: Shot the underworld boss-—indicted for it

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god ruling the underworld
charged means formally accused

explanation.surface: A gangland chief was gunned down and prosecuted for the killing.
explanation.walkthrough: Dis is the Roman ruler of the dead, not a gangster.
explanation.definitionFit: A shot gun has been fired, its load let off.

clue.text: An individual coping with a trying job

definitions.text: An individual coping with a trying job

parts.words: An individual coping with a trying job
parts.note: a trying job sounds like a hard one, but it means a job of trying cases in court

explanation.definitionFit: A justice of the peace or stipendiary hears and tries cases in a lower court.

clue.text: A perfectionist's fancy table

parts.note: a fancy is a notion or idea
a table is a list of data

explanation.surface: A fussy person's ornate piece of furniture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fancy' and 'table' look like adjective and furniture but are nouns for notion and chart.
explanation.definitionFit: An idealist holds lofty standards, demanding things be flawless.

clue.text: He'll kill to get a boat with dope in!

parts.note: SS stands for steamship
an ass is a fool, a dope
taken as written

explanation.surface: A hit man smuggles drugs on board ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dope' looks like drugs but means a fool.
explanation.definitionFit: An assassin is a murderer, especially of a prominent figure.

clue.text: When a brigand gets a letter

parts.note: as can mean when, as in as he left
a pirate is a sea robber, a brigand

explanation.surface: An outlaw receives some post.
explanation.walkthrough: An aspirate is the breathy sound H, so 'a letter' defines it.
explanation.definitionFit: The letter H represents the breathy sound called an aspirate.

clue.text: Stopping two points within the range

indicators.note: within means the two points go inside the range

parts.note: range here means the reach or distance
E and S are two points of the compass

explanation.surface: A gunner halts fire once two targets fall inside the range.
explanation.walkthrough: 'within' signals the container; the two points are compass points, east and south.
explanation.definitionFit: Desistance is the act of ceasing or leaving off.

clue.text: Model politician involved in commercial business

indicators.note: involved in means one piece is wrapped inside another

parts.note: a sale is a commercial transaction
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A politician takes part in trade dealings as an example.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved in' signals the container; 'Model' is a noun meaning an example, not a fashion model.
explanation.definitionFit: A sample is a representative specimen or example.

clue.text: Top-up time for the first course

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the word is written from bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written
an age is a long time

explanation.surface: Time for a refill before the starter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns TOP into POT in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Potage is a thick soup, served as the opening dish of a meal.

clue.text: Be a flier and take off!

parts.note: taken as written
a tit is a small bird

explanation.surface: An instruction to become a pilot and get airborne.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flier' suggests a pilot but means a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Beat it is slang for go away, leave quickly.

clue.text: The player's slow

parts.note: a player of music sees a direction to take a passage at a leisurely pace

explanation.definitionFit: Adagio is the Italian tempo marking for slow playing, also a slow movement.

clue.text: A Red Indian chief could make a long story longer

parts.note: a saga is a long story
more means additional, longer

explanation.surface: A tribal leader whose tales grow with each telling.
explanation.walkthrough: A sagamore is a chief among some Algonquian peoples of North America.
explanation.definitionFit: Sagamore is the Algonquian title for a subordinate chief.

clue.text: Idle in last position

indicators.note: idle letters are loose and unemployed, free to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Lounging around in the final place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Idle' rearranges IN and LAST.
explanation.definitionFit: To install (also spelt with one L) is to place or set in office.

clue.text: Growing source of breakfast-food?

parts.note: read playfully, a crop that yields what goes on toast with bacon

explanation.definitionFit: The aubergine is called this, and whimsically it suggests a vegetable that bears breakfast.

clue.text: A number turned colour, being sensitive

parts.note: ten is a number

indicators.note: turned signals the colour word is read backwards

parts.note: red is a colour

explanation.surface: A figure who blushed, being easily hurt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned' makes DER from RED.
explanation.definitionFit: Tender means sore or easily hurt, painful to the touch.

clue.text: A fan might well be there, and going wild

indicators.note: going wild suggests the letters run riot into a new order

explanation.surface: A supporter at the match gets carried away in the crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going wild' rearranges THERE and AND.
explanation.definitionFit: An adherent is a follower or supporter of a cause or team.
